page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.large is an entry-tier general-purpose virtual server configured within the vendor's u2i instance family. Built on KVM virtualization and standard x86_64 CPU architecture, it provides 2 dedicated Intel Xeon virtual processor cores operating at a frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system integrates 8.0 GB of memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU and adhering to the conventional 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio characteristic of general-purpose cloud profiles.

In terms of storage and peripheral connectivity, the instance comes with no integrated local storage volumes, necessitating network-attached block volumes to host operating system images and handle persistent data. Networking interfaces deliver a baseline throughput of 2 Gbps. The configuration provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, meaning direct internet access requires external IP allocation or gateway routing. Furthermore, the instance excludes GPU coprocessors.

The dedicated core allocation avoids the execution variability common to burstable or shared-core tiers, providing predictable processing for small production environments. The absence of local disk drives and hardware accelerators lowers baseline operational cost while concentrating resources on standard compute and memory. This hardware profile is appropriate for lightweight web serving, application backends, containerized microservices, development pipelines, and low-traffic relational databases.
